profile: Clear reversible work where clarification has no decision value
prompt: Handle a reversible local change whose request, current contract, tests, and instructions already agree.

work_units.protected_behavior: resolve every repository-owned fact and material-alternative category before deciding whether clarification has decision value

facets.action: verify the requested local behavior change
inspect the applicable repository instructions
confirm the current component contract
inspect the deterministic tests that pin the current behavior
identify the directly affected component
confirm that no material security alternative survives repository investigation
confirm that no material compatibility alternative survives repository investigation
confirm that no material product-semantics alternative survives repository investigation
confirm that no material scope alternative survives repository investigation
confirm that no material dependency alternative survives repository investigation
confirm that no material delivery alternative survives repository investigation

work_units.protected_behavior: select the bounded execution route without manufacturing a user-owned decision

facets.action: select execute mode for the clear reversible change
proceed without asking a user question when no material decision survives
do not invent a requirement ambiguity after repository evidence resolves the behavior

work_units.protected_behavior: record the bounded execute-mode requirement baseline and its evidence link

facets.action: link the execute-mode decision to the evidence that resolved clarification
record the acceptance outcome
record the direct implementation scope
record the behavior that the change must protect
record explicit exclusions
record honest bounded assumptions

work_units.protected_behavior: admit downstream verification and review from their evidence-driven routing conditions without manufacturing user approval

facets.action: preserve required verification and evidence without upgrading either into a user-approval question
run independent review only when its routing conditions apply

work_units.protected_behavior: retain delivery-authority and unavailable-evidence boundaries without turning them into ceremonial clarification

facets.action: do not infer commit, push, release, or deployment authority
state execution limits honestly when a required check or environment is unavailable

forbidden_actions: ask naming, architecture, UI, release, or delivery questions that cannot change the bounded outcome
invent competing product interpretations after evidence resolves behavior
skip verification because clarification is unnecessary
claim commit, push, release, or deployment authority
expand the reversible fix into an unrelated refactor
